name: Model for a Day
source:
Model for a Day is a short visual novel that tells the story of an encounter between Finn and Taron. Both will discover new experiences and emotions, letting their instincts lead them. Explore all the options to discover the 3 possible endings.

[From [url=https://fauxnectar.itch.io/model-for-a-day]Itch.io[/url]]
